**The Claude AI free tier in 2026 gives you roughly 15–40 messages per rolling 5-hour window — about 30–100 a day if you spread them out.** That’s the number you searched for, so it goes first. # Claude free plan limits (2026): how many messages you actually get and when you hit the wall
Published: May 2026

Here is the honest version: **Anthropic does not publish a fixed number of messages for the Claude free plan.** No "X messages per day" figure exists on the official pricing page or in the help center. What the company does publish is a relative anchor, the free tier is the one-times usage baseline, and Pro is described as **at least five times the usage per session**
